name: [🎩 Update] Train Your Gubby
desc:
🐇 Welcome to Train Your Gubby! 🐇

In this game, you’ll train your Gubby! When it reaches a certain IQ level, it will learn something new!

How to Play:

- Let it Learn on its own or just Feed it books

- Watch your Gubby get smarter and smarter!

Your Gubby will even gain IQ offline! 🧠✨
[Inspired by Forsaken, Frozen soul (Dream Game) and Grow a garden]
